item.ptxt: Before work, clean off any mud or other foreign matter on the clip.
The fuel tube joint seals the fuel pump tube and fuel suction plate with an O-ring, so take sufficient care not to damage the connection or allow foreign matter to adhere.
Always perform removal and installation by hand without using tools.
Do not forcibly bend, kink or rotate the nylon tube.
After disconnecting, protect the connecting parts with a plastic bag.
If the nylon tube and fuel suction plate are stuck, push and pull to release them.
